raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 19
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the Wikidata P569 (date of birth) value “+1975-08-08T00:00:00Z” as a datetime requiring timezone conversion to America/New_York, applied DST, and extracted the local date (Aug 7, 1975). This is logically incorrect because birth dates are calendar dates (not time-zone–dependent instants) and Wikidata P569 is intended as a date, not a UTC timestamp to be localized. The subtle, plausible UTC-to-local shift caused a one-day error that overrode reliable sources listing August 8, 1975.
